title: Lightning Network payment volume breaks monthly records
content: <div class="tldr-section"><em><strong>TL;DR: The Lightning Network has achieved record monthly payment volumes, signaling a significant leap in Bitcoin's utility for everyday transactions and reinforcing its global adoption as sound money. Meanwhile, the Bitcoin base layer continues its robust operation with a current hashrate of 847.79 EH/s, poised for a likely downward difficulty adjustment in approximately 879 blocks, ensuring the network's self-correcting resilience.
